categories.summary: operating system family, name, version, kernel, architecture; WSL or container
categories.limits: inside WSL or a container this describes the guest, not the host

categories.summary: shells present and their versions (bash, zsh, fish, PowerShell)
categories.limits: PowerShell is started without its profile; shells not on PATH or in standard places are not seen

categories.summary: whether this process runs elevated (root, administrator)
categories.limits: describes buddie's process; no attempt is made to elevate

categories.summary: CPU model, architecture and logical cores
total and available memory; a container's memory limit
categories.limits: available memory on macOS is free + inactive + speculative pages, an estimate

categories.summary: GPU adapters: vendor, model, video memory
categories.limits: NVIDIA models and memory need nvidia-smi; other Linux models need lspci; a WSL guest sees a bridged GPU, not the host's adapters

categories.summary: total and free space of the volume holding a granted directory
Python interpreters on PATH: version, pip, venv, ensurepip; Windows launcher
categories.limits: interpreters not on PATH (conda envs, pyenv shims not on PATH) are not seen; no path is returned

categories.summary: Node.js, Java, .NET runtimes and SDKs, Go, Rust
categories.limits: Java 8 prints its version only on stderr, which buddie does not read: inconclusive

categories.summary: package managers present and their versions
categories.limits: npm, yarn, pnpm on Windows are batch scripts, found but not run

categories.summary: NVIDIA driver and CUDA versions, CUDA toolkit, ROCm; Metal on macOS
categories.limits: nvidia-smi is asked only for its header and compute mode, never for processes

categories.summary: versions of named tools from a fixed catalog
categories.limits: only catalog names are run, each with its fixed version argument

categories.summary: Docker and Podman clients; whether the local Docker daemon answers
categories.limits: the daemon is asked only for its version, on the local default context; podman's machine is not probed; a daemon that does not answer may be stopped or not permitted

categories.summary: project manifests at the top of a granted directory; declared versions
categories.limits: the directory itself only, no search below it; files the agent can write

categories.summary: the git repository at a granted directory: HEAD, clean or dirty, origin

unsupported.why: makes outbound connections to hosts of the request's choosing; not a description of this machine
proxy settings carry credentials and are another program's configuration
probing ports reaches other services and processes
installed applications and their settings are other programs' data, often personal
